title: Titanic construct: detail on the full-size ship, and J's textures on it
desc: J on 951: "now add detail to the 1 to 1 one", then "add and correct and polish some of my existing textures and display it on one of them". Three ways to carry the detail (half-block, quarter-block, a thin overlay on the 1-block ship) and one ship in his BR1 / W1 / H1 textures, polished.

takes.name: Half-block
takes.facts: real size 269 x 28 x 53 (63 to the mast tops), 1 block = 1 m; railings, stays, aerial, davits, cranes, docking bridge, ventilators, skylight, anchors, waterline band, sheer line, lit portholes and windows; forms by F2 circles 1-80, holds to 110; the whole ship re-cut at 2 voxels a block (smoother bow, stern, funnels) + all the detail; 164,820 faces

takes.name: Half-block close-ups (still)
takes.facts: the same take from the funnels camera, fully formed; other cameras in the file: 1 D1 Half-block - bow quarter, 2 D1 Half-block - off the bow, 3 D1 Half-block - boat deck, 4 D1 Half-block - funnels, 5 D1 Half-block - stern
